technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt Spring Cloud Stream application starter architecture for converting Spring XD modules into Spring Boot / Spring Cloud Stream standalone apps.
Utilize Spring Integration channel adapters for sink and source module implementations (FTP, File, Redis, Rabbit, GemFire, Router).
Update Maven/Gradle build configurations to target updated target repositories (s-c-s) with Spring Boot starter dependencies.
Upgrade Hadoop dependencies (HDP/PHD) to compatible versions that support JDK 17 / Spring Framework 6 standards where applicable.
assumptions: The developer has access to existing Spring XD source repositories and target Spring Cloud Stream repositories.
Unit and integration test suites exist in Spring XD and can be ported/adapted to Spring Cloud Stream testing frameworks.
No major architectural re-design is required for the modules beyond standard Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream conversion patterns.
The work will be performed by a single experienced Java/Spring developer.

activities.activity_description: Set up build environment, clone s-c-s and Spring XD repositories, and prepare base pom/gradle build templates for ported modules.
Extract router module code from XD, adapt configuration to Spring Cloud Stream sink conventions, write unit tests, and create s-c-s PR.
Port file sink module to s-c-s, configure Spring Integration File outbound adapter, and verify file writing functionality.
Port FTP sink module to s-c-s, configure FTP outbound channel adapter, spring boot properties, and integration tests with mock FTP server.
Move Redis sink module from XD to s-c-s, update Spring Data Redis configuration, auto-configuration properties, and integration tests.
Move RabbitMQ source module to s-c-s, adapt inbound channel adapter and Spring AMQP bindings, and implement test cases.
Move GemFire sink module to s-c-s repo, update Spring Data GemFire dependencies, auto-configuration, and verification tests.
Update HDP and PHD distro versions in Spring XD build dependencies, resolve breaking API changes, and verify HDFS integration tasks.
Author user documentation detailing migration paths, backward compatibility concerns, and breaking changes from Spring XD 1.2 to 1.3 releases.

activities.activity_name: End-to-End Build Verification and Integration Testing
activities.activity_description: Run full test suite across all ported modules in s-c-s, address regression failures, and ensure build automation pipeline readiness.
